e^(2 log k) = k^2, so product of roots 2k^2 - 1 = 7 gives k^2 = 4 and k = 2 (k>0 for log k to exist); discriminant 9k^2 - 4(2k^2-1) = k^2+4 > 0, so the roots are real at k = 2.
A adj A = det(A) I = (10a+3b)I. AA^T = [[25a^2+b^2, 15a-2b],[15a-2b, 13]]. Off-diagonal gives 15a = 2b; the (2,2) entry gives 10a+3b = 13, so a = 2/5, b = 3 and 5a+b = 5 (consistent: 25a^2+b^2 = 13).
The determinant of the coefficient matrix reduces to lambda(lambda-1)(lambda+1), which vanishes at lambda = 0, 1, -1 — exactly three values.
